rubric.text: Represents molecules in a string encoding whose every mutation still decodes to a valid molecule (SELFIES), rather than mutating SMILES and discarding the invalid results.
Evolves by random single-character insertions and replacements on that string encoding, without a crossover operator.
Scores each molecule with the objective plus a weighted discriminator term, F = J + beta * D, so fitness is not the objective alone.

The discriminator is a model trained during the run to tell the evolving population apart from a reference set of real molecules, and is retrained as the population changes, so molecules that linger lose fitness and the search is pushed off stale optima.
Replaces the weakest members of the population with mutants of the fittest, rather than restarting or keeping everything.
Raises the discriminator's weight when the search stops improving, as an adaptive escape from stagnation.
Keeps violating molecules out by giving them a large fitness penalty rather than by filtering only at the end.

provenance: Rubric written from arXiv:1909.11655 Secs. 2-3 before any scored run.
